Emily — thanks for the term sheet, and congrats again on the selection of the initial pilot customers. Quick read: overall looks reasonable but we need to align operationally on a few points before legal gets involved. Bullet list below — if you can reply inline or confirm, we’ll produce a short mutual action plan and hand to deal ops.

- Lead registration: Redwood requires a 30-day demo-to-opportunity window and a HubSpot ticket with source "partner-intro". Can Catalyst confirm you can provide that metadata at handoff?
- Intro credit: we typically offer a one-time $1k demo credit per qualified lead, capped at $20k per calendar quarter during pilot. Is that acceptable?
- Revenue split: term sheet proposes 15/85 (Catalyst/Redwood) for initial 12-month pilots, then to be renegotiated on usage thresholds. We need a floor guarantee for Redwood if monthly MRR < $5k.
- Exclusivity: Catalyst asked about vertical exclusivity during pilot — we prefer non-exclusive but can discuss co-marketing prioritized lead routing.
- Technical: can you confirm expected monthly requests distribution (p50/p95) so we can size burst capacity for Dedicated routing?

Attachments for internal context: redwood_catalyst_MVP_integration_notes.pdf (internal)

If the above is OK, Marissa — can you draft a 1-page MAP and milestone dates (dev handoff, pilot start, first invoice) for this week? I’ll propose a follow-up meeting with Tom from legal.

Best,
